title: Boxing Basics
subtitle: 10 short lessons from stance to your first combos

lessons.title: Stance & guard
lessons.subtitle: The position every punch starts from
lessons.keyPoint: Hands up, chin down, weight on the balls of your feet.

steps.title: Feet
steps.body: Stand side-on, feet about shoulder-width apart. Your lead foot points forward, your rear foot turns out slightly, heel a little off the floor.

steps.title: Knees
steps.body: Soft knees, never locked. Your weight is shared between both feet, on the balls of your feet.

steps.title: Hands
steps.body: Lead glove at eye height a little in front of your face, rear glove touching your cheek. Elbows in, protecting your ribs.

steps.title: Chin
steps.body: Tuck your chin down slightly and look through your eyebrows.

mistakes.wrong: Feet in one line, like on a tightrope
mistakes.fix: Keep them shoulder-width apart for balance
Gloves stay up at your face
Chin down, knees soft

practice.description: Hold your stance for 45 seconds and react to the voice.

lessons.title: Footwork
lessons.subtitle: Move without losing your stance
lessons.keyPoint: The foot closest to where you're going moves first.

steps.title: Step forward
steps.body: Push off your rear foot and step your lead foot forward a short distance. Then bring the rear foot up the same distance.

steps.title: Step back
steps.body: Push off your lead foot, step the rear foot back, then the lead foot follows.

steps.title: Side to side
steps.body: To move left, step with the left foot first. To move right, the right foot first.

steps.title: Stay in stance
steps.body: Small steps. Your feet never cross or come together, and your hands stay up.

mistakes.fix: The leading foot moves first, the other follows
Small, quick steps keep you balanced
Guard up the whole time

practice.description: Move as the voice calls each step. One short step each time.

lessons.title: The jab
lessons.subtitle: Number 1 · your lead hand
lessons.keyPoint: Fast out, faster back to your face.

steps.title: Start in guard
steps.body: Stance set, both gloves up.

steps.title: Extend straight
steps.body: Push your lead glove straight out from your chin towards the target. Your elbow stays down, behind the punch.

steps.title: Turn the fist
steps.body: Turn your fist over at the end so your palm faces down. Your lead shoulder rises to protect your chin.

steps.title: Snap back
steps.body: Bring the glove straight back to your face the same way it went out.

mistakes.wrong: Elbow flaring out to the side
mistakes.fix: Elbow points down, the punch travels in a straight line

mistakes.wrong: Leaving the arm out after the punch
mistakes.fix: Snap it straight back to your guard

mistakes.wrong: Rear hand drops when you jab
mistakes.fix: Rear glove stays glued to your cheek

practice.description: Hit spot 1 on the bag when it's called. Two rounds of 45 seconds.

lessons.title: The cross
lessons.subtitle: Number 2 · your rear hand
lessons.keyPoint: The power comes from turning your rear hip and foot.

steps.title: Start in guard
steps.body: Stance set, both gloves up.

steps.title: Pivot
steps.body: Turn your rear foot on the ball of the foot as if squashing a bug, and turn your rear hip forward.

steps.title: Extend straight
steps.body: Let the rear glove travel straight from your chin to the target as your hips and shoulders turn.

steps.title: Snap back
steps.body: Bring it straight back to your cheek and reset your stance.

mistakes.fix: Turn the rear foot and hip with the punch

mistakes.wrong: Leaning forward past your front knee
mistakes.fix: Keep your head over your lead knee, no further
Lead glove stays up to protect your face

practice.description: Hit spot 2 when it's called, and 1-2 now and then.

lessons.title: The 1-2
lessons.subtitle: Your first combination
lessons.keyPoint: The jab comes back as the cross goes out.

steps.title: Jab
steps.body: Throw a quick jab and start bringing it back right away.

steps.title: Cross
steps.body: As the jab returns, pivot and throw the cross.

steps.title: One rhythm
steps.body: Think "one-two" as a single movement, not two separate punches.

steps.title: Reset
steps.body: Both hands back to your face, stance set, ready again.

mistakes.wrong: A long pause between the punches
mistakes.fix: Flow from one into the other

mistakes.wrong: Both hands out at the same time
mistakes.fix: One hand out, the other always guarding

practice.description: Throw the 1-2 each time it's called.

lessons.title: The lead hook
lessons.subtitle: Number 3 · a curved punch from the side
lessons.keyPoint: Turn your whole body. The arm just stays locked in its shape.

steps.title: Arm shape
steps.body: Raise your lead elbow to shoulder height with a bent arm, about a right angle.

steps.title: Turn
steps.body: Pivot on your lead foot and turn your hips and shoulders. The glove swings across in a short curve.

steps.title: Stay compact
steps.body: The glove travels only a short distance. Don't wind up or swing wide.

steps.title: Back to guard
steps.body: Turn back and return the glove to your face.

mistakes.fix: Start from your guard, no wind-up
Keep the arm bent and the curve short
Pivot the foot with the hips

practice.description: Hit spot 3 on the side of the bag, sometimes after a jab.

lessons.title: The rear hook
lessons.subtitle: Number 4 · the hook from your power side
lessons.keyPoint: Pivot the rear foot and turn the rear hip, like the cross.

steps.title: Arm shape
steps.body: Rear elbow up to shoulder height, arm bent about a right angle.

steps.title: Turn
steps.body: Pivot your rear foot and turn your rear hip forward. The glove swings across in a short curve.

steps.title: Guard
steps.body: Your lead glove stays at your face the whole time.

steps.title: Back to guard
steps.body: Turn back and return the glove to your cheek.

mistakes.fix: Turn the foot and hip first
Stop the turn when your chest faces the target

practice.description: Hit spot 4, and the 3-4 hook pair.

lessons.title: Uppercuts
lessons.subtitle: Numbers 5 and 6 · punches that travel upward
lessons.keyPoint: Bend your knees a little, then drive up with your legs.

steps.title: Dip
steps.body: Bend your knees slightly and drop your level a few centimetres. Don't lean or drop your hand.

steps.title: Drive up
steps.body: Push up with your legs and turn your hip. The glove travels upward with your palm facing you.

steps.title: Short and close
steps.body: Keep the elbow bent and the punch close to your body.

steps.title: 5 and 6
steps.body: 5 is the lead hand, 6 is the rear hand. Same movement, opposite side.

mistakes.wrong: Dropping the hand low before punching
mistakes.fix: Bend the knees instead; the glove stays near your chest
Stay upright and balanced

practice.description: Hit spots 5 and 6 at the bottom of the bag.

lessons.title: Defense basics
lessons.subtitle: Block, slip and roll
lessons.keyPoint: Small, quick movements, then right back to your stance.

steps.title: Block
steps.body: Raise both gloves to your forehead and keep your elbows tight. Absorb, don't reach.

steps.title: Slip
steps.body: Bend your knees slightly and turn your shoulders so your head moves just off the centre line.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: Bend your knees and move your head down and across in a small U shape, under an imaginary punch.

steps.title: Reset
steps.body: After every move, come back to your stance with your hands up.

mistakes.fix: Bend with your knees

mistakes.wrong: Closing your eyes or looking at the floor
mistakes.fix: Keep your eyes forward
Move just enough, then reset

practice.description: Do each move as the voice calls it.

lessons.title: Put it together
lessons.subtitle: Your first full workout
lessons.keyPoint: Stay relaxed and breathe out on every punch.

steps.title: Combos
steps.body: Everything you've learned: 1-2, 1-2-3, uppercuts, in short combinations.

steps.title: Rhythm
steps.body: Throw the combo, return to guard, breathe, ready for the next call.

steps.title: Pace yourself
steps.body: Three rounds of one minute. Speed and form beat power.

steps.title: Next
steps.body: When this feels easy, move on to the Reaction Drills.

mistakes.fix: Breathe out sharply on each punch
Steady pace over three rounds

practice.description: Three rounds of mixed combos called on the bag.
